data.text: Define which mobs will spawn inside the CubeGenerator and with what probability. The pattern follows the format: MobName: 'EntityType:Count:Percentage'.

items.content: Mob Name: The key is the display/reference name for the mob (e.g., ZOMBIE, CREEPER).
EntityType: The Bukkit/Spigot entity type (e.g., ZOMBIE, CREEPER). Must match the valid entity types.
Count: The number of entities to spawn at the generator place each time.
Percentage: The probability percentage of this mob being chosen when spawning. The sum of percentages across all mobs defines the distribution.
